full_details: Field called from his own shop, with a book he did not print. It came yesterday from Cambridge. He will not tell you what the margin calls you. Harrison has copies at the Greyhound. Tomorrow at ten, at Paul's. Your jaw is the size of an egg, and you are not fit to be praised. Woburn burned on Saturday, and a stationer is already rushing a godly tract through the press. You said you would write to Quiney tonight. He asked for his Holinshed, and you ended on God keep thee. On the Bishopsgate post, two bills. Your house's old Hamlet, and at the Rose a new play, The New World's Tragedy. You read that title twice. A new world, a fortnight after Drake sailed. You set three words on the tables, Quiney, the certificate, and tonight, and nothing under them. In the afternoon the cry on your side was revenge, through the clove.
one_sentence: You agreed to come at ten, read a new title twice on the Bishopsgate post, and cried revenge through a clove.
title: Read a new title and cried revenge through a clove
